layman_headline: Market fear is building and the available swing trades are too risky to justify an entry right now.

layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market mood is fearful and worsening, and none of today's trade candidates offer a safe enough entry point. A better opportunity will come when fear peaks and reverses, or when a quality coin pulls back to clear support with volume confirmation.
